(Currently amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer located on opposite sides of a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are aligned with each other; and an additional adhesive layer bonded to at least one of the first or second adhesive layers. 

(Original) Claim 282: The tool of claim 281 wherein the first adhesive layer is configured to bond a first layer to a second layer.

(Original) Claim 283: The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises a composite material.

(Original) Claim 284: The tool of claim 283 wherein the composite material is filled with a second material.
